Fill only the empty reader-facing strings in the skeleton. Do not alter identities, exact question, weights, sections, move counts/order/links, ratings, or scores. Tags and blunder links remain empty until fresh rhetorical review. Do not run any calculator.

Each critique must contain105–130words AND at least880characters, exactly four labeled and terminally punctuated sentences: Strongest feature:, Principal limitation:, Live burden:, Locked score:. No extra periods from abbreviations. Use ordinary English punctuation.

Self-check all numerical, structural, quote and prose constraints in memory before first output submission. You may send literal draft components in tool output to the controller for mechanical compilation if transport requires it, but do not create undeclared draft files or overwrite submitted output. The checker may inspect frozen scores but never calculate them.

Write three concrete overall strengths and two material limitations per side, each tied to the actual weighted record; do not inflate weaker performance or treat an overall result as worldview truth. Aim roughly25–40words per item where that supports complete reasoning.

The AI Contribution is separate unscored reasoning, disclosed at section level by the site. Write direct substantive thesis/premises/conclusion and three distinct new arguments per side. Novelty map must explain how every extension item strengthens or repairs specific live argument(s), and distinguish genuinely new reasoning. Never attribute this added reasoning to the speakers.
